## Hypothesis

The monotone OOS exp/tr edge observed in WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE ($36.34→$59.02→$66.13 for 0DTE→1DTE→2DTE) continues to 3DTE and 4DTE due to further reduced theta decay on entry premium. Longer DTE preserves more of the directional signal's intrinsic value by lowering time-sensitive erosion, especially for ITM-2 puts where theta accelerates near expiry.

## Mechanism

Identical to WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE: trigger on `vwap_continuation` signal (first ≤10:30-ET bar continuing in-trend after first 3 RTH closes on one side of session VWAP), enter at next bar open, ITM-2 strike, -8%/+30% exit rules. Only DTE variable changes: test 3DTE and 4DTE weekly options using same expiry selection logic as 1DTE/2DTE (nearest weekly expiry ≥ target DTE). Uses real OPRA fill simulation from upcoming `options_3dte/4dte` backfill.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account (per risk-rules.md); $1K paper ≈14% headline P&L. Extending to 3DTE/4DTE increases entry premium (lower theta decay) → higher capital requirement per contract but same qty scaling applies.
2. **Sample bias:** Uses same signal population as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE (n≈1,200 triggers over 16mo). Extending DTE window adds no new signals, only changes contract selection. Overfit risk low as mechanism is structural (theta decay) not signal-specific.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (reliant on imminent OP-16 backfill for 3DTE/4DTE; will compute walk-forward held-out window once data available).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (pending OP-16 backfill; will validate top 3 J days via realistic simulator against cached OPRA).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: gap risk at open (mitigated by -8% stop). Max drawdown: extended DTE may increase overnight gap exposure (though held% ~0 per -8% stop). Blow-up scenario: volatile reversal triggering stop then adverse gap (e.g., 5/07 call loser pattern).
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days for 0DTE/1DTE/2DTE were ~45% of P&L (per leaderboard). Expect similar distribution for 3DTE/4DTE as signal-driven; will disclose post-backtest.
